method: Spot list from the Surfnerd country pages (surf-reports/portugal, surf-reports/spain) and the Surf-Forecast.com country break lists; facts from each Surfnerd .md page and the matched Surf-Forecast.com break page, fetched 1 per second per site. Spain is filtered to the Atlantic and Cantabrian coasts and the Canaries (Mediterranean, Strait-east and Ceuta excluded). Nearest sources: wave buoys and Instituto Hidrografico / IGN / IHM tide gauges from the EMODnet Physics platform registry (ERDDAP EP_PLATFORMS_METADATA_V2, which carries Puertos del Estado and Instituto Hidrografico platforms), tide gauges from the IOC Sea Level Station Monitoring Facility station list, airports from the Iowa Environmental Mesonet PT__ASOS / ES__ASOS networks. live = last observation on or after 2026-11-06 (EMODnet), status active with observations in the last day (IOC), online flag (IEM). NDBC activestations lists no Iberian, Canary or Madeira partner buoys (checked).
